Well, let me think this through. I've been doing this 30 years on these same fields, so I mostly know what to do, but each year's a bit different.

My 40 mu — I keep 25 mu in wheat-maize rotation on the better land near the road, where the soil is heavier and holds water. The other 15 mu is my cotton ground, sandier, out west. That's how I've set it up since the kids left, and it works. With just me and the wife at home, 40 mu is about all we can handle, and cotton picking is the hardest part — I'll need to hire some help in the fall like always.

For the wheat (already in the ground since mid-October, Jimai 22 like most folks around here), the green-up looked alright when I walked the fields last week. I'll topdress urea at jointing, probably around 12 kg/mu — plus the base fertilizer I put down with planting (compound fertilizer, about 40 kg/mu of 15-15-15), that puts me at a decent N rate. The extension guy came through last year and said 15 kg/mu N was enough, but I usually go a bit heavier to be safe — a bad wheat year hurts more than a few extra yuan on fertilizer. I'll irrigate three times for sure: greening, jointing, grain fill. Four if May is dry. Water from the tube well isn't cheap with the electric meter, but you can't skimp on wheat water.

For maize — goes in right after wheat comes off in June, very tight, maybe 3-4 days. I hire the no-till planter, Zhenghongnuo 2 or similar hybrid. One base fertilizer application and one topdress at big flare leaf. Usually one irrigation if July is dry, sometimes two. My maize does about 500 kg/mu most years.

Cotton — this is where I have to decide more each year because prices bounce around. I'm sticking with it for now, 15 mu, plant late April after the soil warms up. I'll go with the same variety I had last year since it yielded okay. Cotton takes a lot of spraying for bollworm and aphids, I'll do 4-5 sprays through the season. Picking takes forever — I'll hire 4-5 day laborers in September-October for each pick.

Cash budget — I've got about 28,000 yuan set aside for inputs this season from last year's sales. That should cover everything with maybe 2,000 yuan cushion for emergencies.
